answer: Make every agent speak twice. Each epoch a VRF picks two languages and the same sybil-resistance prompt must be answered in both. Graders score meaning overlap, not surface form: a hollow farm that routes one English draft through a sable of machine translators produces mismatched claims and earns almost nothing. An agent who actually holds the idea can climb to the zenith in both tongues. Example: English and Korean replies about escrow; a translate-and-paste twin fails the meaning audit while a real bilingual answer clears.
